title: Bonus Episode: Psychologists Address Climate Change

sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to a special episode of Speaking of Psychology, a podcast from the
sentences.zh: 您好，欢迎收听《心理学谈话》特别节目，这是来自

sentences.en: American Psychological Association that explores the connections between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 美国心理学会的一档播客，旨在探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Caitlin Luna.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人凯特琳·卢纳。

sentences.en: This special episode features a report by APA's
sentences.zh: 本期特别节目将为您带来由美国心理学会的

sentences.en: Kim Mills, who attended the first ever international summit on psychology's contributions to global health in Lisbon, Portugal in November.
sentences.zh: 金·米尔斯撰写的报道。去年11月，她在葡萄牙里斯本参加了首届心理学对全球健康贡献国际峰会。

sentences.en: The summit, sponsored by APA and the Association of
sentences.zh: 此次峰会由美国心理学会和

sentences.en: Portuguese Psychologists, brought together leaders of psychological associations from more than 40
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙心理学家协会共同主办，汇集了来自五大洲40多个

sentences.en: nations on five continents to explore ways of applying psychological science to the global problem of climate change.
sentences.zh: 国家的心理学协会领导人，共同探讨如何将心理科学应用于气候变化这一全球性问题。

sentences.en: The summit kicked off with several psychologists describing climate change's impact in their countries.
sentences.zh: 峰会伊始，几位心理学家分别描述了气候变化在各自国家造成的影响。

sentences.en: Jean Young-che, Secretary of External Affairs for the Korean
sentences.zh: 韩国心理学会对外事务秘书长让·杨哲

sentences.en: Psychological Association, described how microdust is engulfing the country and noted evidence suggesting a connection between dementia and exposure to the fine particles.
sentences.zh: 描述了微尘如何笼罩该国，并指出有证据表明痴呆症与接触这些细颗粒物之间存在关联。

sentences.en: Ava Thompson, past president of the Bahamas Psychological Association, noted the increasing frequency and power of hurricanes in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 巴哈马心理学会前任主席艾娃·汤普森指出，加勒比地区飓风的频率和强度正在增加。

sentences.en: And Brian Dixon, Director of Scientific Issues for the
sentences.zh: 而新西兰心理学会科学事务主任布莱恩·迪克森

sentences.en: New Zealand Psychological Society, described how flooding is devastating his city and surrounding areas.
sentences.zh: 描述了洪水如何摧毁了他的城市及周边地区。

sentences.en: Well, we're a coastal nation, and all of our borders are threatened by climate change with increasing sea levels, increasing storm events.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个沿海国家，随着海平面上升和风暴事件增多，我们所有的边界都受到气候变化的威胁。

sentences.en: But we also have problems with our glaciers, late snowfall, and those are major tourist attractions for us.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的冰川和降雪延迟问题也十分严重，而这些正是我们主要的旅游景点。

sentences.en: And our food production areas, which are subject to drought and flooding more frequently now than they have been in the paSt. Our territorial realm
sentences.zh: 我们的粮食产区现在比过去更频繁地遭受干旱和洪水的侵袭。我们的领土范围

sentences.en: covers a lot of the Pacific, which means that a large number of climate change migrants and refugees
sentences.zh: 覆盖了太平洋的大片区域，这意味着大量的气候变化移民和难民

sentences.en: are likely to come to our country, which would place a huge stress on our health systems, our mental health systems, and just our community resources.
sentences.zh: 很可能会来到我国，这将给我们的卫生系统、心理健康系统以及社区资源带来巨大压力。

sentences.en: The attendees issued a proclamation committing each organization to work together on the United
sentences.zh: 与会者发表了一项宣言，承诺各组织将共同致力于实现联合国

sentences.en: Nations Sustainable Development Goal No.
sentences.zh: 可持续发展目标第13项，

sentences.en: 13, which calls for taking action to combat climate change and its impacts.
sentences.zh: 该目标呼吁采取行动应对气候变化及其影响。

sentences.en: They also adopted a resolution committing them to, among other things, helping people prepare
sentences.zh: 他们还通过了一项决议，承诺在其他事项之外，帮助人们做好

sentences.en: for and adapt to climate change, even as psychologists work to change the behaviors that have caused it.
sentences.zh: 应对和适应气候变化的准备，同时心理学家们也将致力于改变导致气候变化的行为。

sentences.en: The president of Portugal, Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, addressed the summit, telling attendees they had chosen
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙总统马塞洛·雷贝洛·德索萨在峰会上发表讲话，告诉与会者他们选择

sentences.en: the right subject to tackle first because of the global nature of climate change.
sentences.zh: 了一个正确的首要议题，因为气候变化具有全球性。

sentences.en: We must have a global response to it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须对此做出全球性的响应。

sentences.en: There is not a single country, even a superpower, that can alone address this issue.
sentences.zh: 没有一个国家，即使是超级大国，能够独自解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Many of the attendees agreed with the president's assessment.
sentences.zh: 许多与会者赞同总统的评估。

sentences.en: Dr. Christine Roland-Levy, president of the
sentences.zh: 国际应用心理学会主席

sentences.en: International Association of Applied Psychology, was one.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀·罗兰-莱维博士就是其中之一。

sentences.en: We really have to be global and take into account the differences in terms of cultures, in terms of habits, in terms of global warming as a whole.
sentences.zh: 我们确实必须具有全球视野，并考虑到文化、习惯以及全球变暖整体情况方面的差异。

sentences.en: So problems are not always the same.
sentences.zh: 所以问题并不总是相同的。

sentences.en: Focus should be different according to countries, but we should, and we need to have the same goal, protect the planet, make it a better world for the future, make it a better
sentences.zh: 各国应根据自身情况采取不同的侧重点，但我们应该，也需要拥有同一个目标：保护地球，为未来创造一个更美好的世界，为

sentences.en: world for the future generations.
sentences.zh: 子孙后代创造一个更美好的世界。

sentences.en: So that's the main point.
sentences.zh: 这就是核心要点。

sentences.en: APA CEO Dr. Arthur Evans Jr.
sentences.zh: 美国心理学会首席执行官亚瑟·埃文斯博士

sentences.en: called the meeting a landmark for psychology around the world.
sentences.zh: 称这次会议是全球心理学的一个里程碑。

sentences.en: He and Francisco Miranda Rodriguez, president of the Association of Portuguese Psychologists, agreed to continue to provide administrative support to the international associations
sentences.zh: 他和葡萄牙心理学家协会主席弗朗西斯科·米兰达·罗德里格斯一致同意，在他们回国并开始实施商定的部分策略后，
zh_words: 弗朗西斯科·米兰达·罗德里格斯

sentences.en: after they return home and begin to implement some of the tactics agreed upon.
sentences.zh: 继续为国际协会提供行政支持。

sentences.en: These will include a systematic review of existing research, plus new cross-cultural research,
sentences.zh: 这些策略将包括对现有研究进行系统性回顾，开展新的跨文化研究，

sentences.en: seeking increased funding from government and philanthropic sources, and conducting interdisciplinary workshops and conferences.
sentences.zh: 寻求政府和慈善机构增加资金支持，以及举办跨学科研讨会和会议。

sentences.en: Other ideas that emerged included holding sessions on climate change at each association's annual conference, devoting special issues of their journals to the topic,
sentences.zh: 其他涌现出的想法包括：在各协会的年度会议上举办关于气候变化的会议，在期刊上刊登相关主题的特刊，

sentences.en: sponsoring publicity campaigns, and training psychologists about how to change behavior and help people cope with climate change and climate disasters.
sentences.zh: 赞助宣传活动，并培训心理学家如何改变行为，帮助人们应对气候变化和气候灾难。

sentences.en: I think that people came with some energy and excitement about the topic, but I think people are leaving with a commitment to really work on this issue going forward.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们带着对这个话题的活力和兴奋而来，但我认为人们离开时带着一种致力于在未来真正解决这个问题的承诺。

sentences.en: And not only that, I think we educated each other, both having experts that came to the room,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，我认为我们互相教育了对方，既有来到现场与我们交谈的专家，

sentences.en: into the room to talk with us, but also people who had lived experience, psychologists who were in
sentences.zh: 也有拥有生活经验的人，即那些身处

sentences.en: countries that were affected by climate change, and they had an opportunity to talk about the psychological impact and toll in the world that they saw psychology playing.
sentences.zh: 受气候变化影响国家的心理学家，他们有机会谈论心理影响，以及他们所看到的心理学在世界范围内发挥的作用。

sentences.en: So I think that combination was really powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这种结合非常有力。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kim Mills, for that interesting report from the summit in Lisbon.
sentences.zh: 感谢金·米尔斯从里斯本峰会发回的这篇精彩报道。

sentences.en: I hope we'll have more to say about psychology and climate change in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 希望在接下来的几个月里，我们能就心理学和气候变化进行更多的讨论。

sentences.en: For more information about the summit and to view a video of portions of the meeting, go to our website, speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多关于峰会的信息并观看会议部分视频，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: You can find previous episodes of Speaking of Psychology on Apple, Stitcher, Spotify, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 您可以在Apple、Stitcher、Spotify或任何您获取播客的地方找到《心理学谈话》往期节目。

sentences.en: You can also go to speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 您也可以访问 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: I'm Caitlin Luna with the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 我是凯特琳·卢纳，来自美国心理

sentences.en: Association.
sentences.zh: 学会。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的收听。
